title: W3C Pointer Events Level 3
relevance: Pointer Events define one event model for mouse, pen, and touch pointers. That makes them the right baseline for Apple Pencil and tablet/stylus hardware.

title: MDN: touch-action
relevance: The drawing surface must disable browser gesture handling on the SVG so pen/touch strokes reach the application.

title: D3: d3-drag
relevance: The existing repository uses D3 for SVG interaction and rendering, but native Pointer Events are simpler for separating draw mode from select/move mode.

title: perfect-freehand
relevance: A specialized freehand stroke library that can convert pressure-aware input into rendered stroke outlines. Useful for drawing apps, but heavier than needed for link-center extraction.

title: Paper.js Path.simplify
relevance: Paper.js provides path simplification tools. This demo only needs distance-based point reduction, so a small local helper is enough.
